question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The doctor directed the nurse to administer an ______ medicine to the patient.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Alternative.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Official**: a person holding public office or having official duties, especially as a representative of an organization or government department. (अधिकारी)
 
• **Eminent**: Noticeable or worth remarking on, or very great. (प्रसिद्ध)
 
• **Alternative**: One or more things available as another possibility or choice. (वैकल्पिक)
 
• **Insightful**:** **Showing a clear and usually original understanding of a complicated problem or situation. (किसी जटिल समस्या या स्थिति की स्पष्ट और आमतौर पर मूल समझ दिखाना)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "Alternative" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: The nurse was instructed by the doctor to give the patient a different medication.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete sentence: *The doctor directed the nurse to administer an **alternative __**medicine to the patient.*
